viewportMode.title: Poll only the clients' viewport
viewportMode.description: false polls bbox (or the globe) continuously.

bbox.title: Fixed bounding box
bbox.description: lamin,lomin,lamax,lomax; used only when viewportMode is false. Empty means the globe.

viewportTtlSec.title: Area lease TTL (s)
viewportTtlSec.description: A pushed area expires after this long without a refresh.

maxAreaSqDeg.title: Area above which polling slows (sq deg)

creditFloor.title: Credit floor
creditFloor.description: Below this many remaining daily credits, poll at the slowest interval.
